From 5875781c52e030c221fcf9a04f2bde3c8075fe4f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Josh Elser <elserj@apache.org>
Date: Sun, 22 Jun 2014 17:16:26 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] ACCUMULO-2935 Add a timeout to a test that otherwise hung
 indefinitely


diff --git a/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java b/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
index 6d059212a6..4ea2663740 100644
--- a/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
+++ b/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@ import org.junit.Test;
 
 public class MetaSplitIT extends SimpleMacIT {
 
-  @Test(expected = AccumuloException.class)
+  @Test(expected = AccumuloException.class, timeout = 30000)
   public void testRootTableSplit() throws Exception {
     TableOperations opts = getConnector().tableOperations();
     SortedSet<Text> splits = new TreeSet<Text>();
-- 
2.25.1

**Modifications in Each File:**

1. **MetaSplitIT.java**
   - The test annotation for the method `testRootTableSplit` was modified to include a `timeout` parameter. The timeout is set to 30,000 milliseconds (30 seconds), which will cause the test to fail if it runs longer than this duration.

**Relationships:**

- The modification in `MetaSplitIT.java` addresses the issue of the test hanging indefinitely. By adding a timeout, it ensures that the test will terminate after 30 seconds if it does not complete, preventing potential blocking during test execution. This change is directly related to resolving the problem described in ACCUMULO-2935.
